relevance_note: A 1971 biochemical study of lipoproteins from named patients with familial LCAT deficiency: "Two female patients previously described, A. R., age 36 yr (1, 2) and A. A., age 42 yr (4), were studied."
method_note: Written by hand-built Python script from my own reading; no table transcribed by script. Three in-scope people: A. R. and A. A. (the two patients studied) and M. R., 'the sister of A. R.', named with them as one of 'three patients with familial LCAT deficiency' and given unpublished small-HDL values. No LCAT variant or gene test is described (pre-molecular era, diagnosis by biochemistry), so the variants table is empty; there is no person-linked variant to record as 'not reported'. Year of publication is not printed on the article itself (only received/revised dates 1970), so year is null. Disease features in the Introduction (corneal infiltration, anemia, proteinuria, elevated unesterified cholesterol, reduced cholesteryl ester) are general statements about the disease, not about these patients, so no checklist item uses them. Lipid data are lipoprotein-fraction compositions (Tables II-IV, per mg protein or per ml plasma, without plasma reference ranges); the checklist items low HDL cholesterol, low LDL/apoB, hypertriglyceridemia, elevated free cholesterol and reduced cholesteryl ester fraction were left 'not reported' because the paper reports HDL/LDL protein concentration and lipoprotein composition, not these plasma measures; the reported abnormalities are recorded as phenotypic_features rows instead. Attribution of 'The concentration of HDL protein before the diet was about 15% of normal' to A. A. rests on a displaced paragraph (after the reference list) that discusses A. A.'s diet and her Table IV; the preceding text is garbled in the conversion. is_proband left null (no proband named). Age 36 yr / 42 yr recorded as age at evaluation (age at study). M. R.'s sex taken from 'sister'. The garbled OCR text (e.g. 'The patients' LDL of d u r markedly heterogeneous') was not quoted. No contradictions found.
